title: Evaluation of sample pooling in SARS-CoV-2 testing using the Taq- Path COVID-19 Combo Kit
author: Meletis, G.
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Test positives individually
steps.instruction: Run each of the four confirmed positive nasopharyngeal specimens separately on the TaqPath COVID‑19 Combo Kit according to the kit’s standard RT‑qPCR protocol.

steps.title: Create five‑sample pools
steps.instruction: For each positive specimen, combine it with four different confirmed negative nasopharyngeal specimens to form a pool containing five samples; mix the pool thoroughly before proceeding to RNA extraction.

steps.title: Run pooled reactions with varied RNA input
steps.instruction: Set up RT‑qPCR reactions for each pool using the TaqPath COVID‑19 Combo Kit with three RNA input volumes: 5 µL (standard), 10 µL, and 15 µL per reaction to assess sensitivity and assay performance.
